This week's beauty launches: Forest Essential's night cream, Victoria Beckham Beauty's eyeshadow sticks and more...
Sophie Smith
03 March 2023
Twitter
Facebook
Linkedin
WhatsApp
This week's beauty launches include a Rejuvenating Cannabinoid Face Serum from Cellular Goods, Molton Brown's Heavenly Gingerlily bath and bodycare collection, an eyeshadow stick range from Victoria Beckham Beauty, and more.
Victoria Beckham Beauty introduces new eyeshadow stick range
Victoria Beckham Beauty
has unveiled its new EyeWear Crease-Proof Eyeshadow stick, which comes in a range of nuanced shades and finishes inspired by Creative Director Victoria Beckham's own wardrobe and colour-blocking style.
EyeWear is created from a "lightweight, long-lasting formula with a buttery soft texture" enabling the wearer to create various looks from minimalist washes of colour to sultry smoky eyes with ease and without the need for an additional base or tools.
“Inspired by my fashion house, our new longwear, crease-proof eyeshadow stick is a seven-shade collection that represents my ultimate wardrobe lookbook. It’s incredibly versatile and the formula is completely clean, nothing like the eyeshadow stick of years past.” Victoria Beckham said.
The product comes in seven shades including Pecan, Sunflower, Macaron, Bottle Green, Caramel, Trench and Oyster. I
ngredients include Vitas Vita, which i
ncreases collagen synthesis for improvement in skin elasticity, tonicity and firmness, and Seaweed (Fucus) Oil, a soothing emollient that dissipates subcutaneous fat deposits on the lower portion of eyelid for smoother looking lids.
Priced at £28, the EyeWear eyeshadow sticks are available at
Victoria Beckham Beauty
.
Forest Essentials launches serum-infused night cream
Luxury Indian Ayurvedic beauty brand Forest Essentials has launched a Transformative Soundarya Night Cream.
Promising to be the "ultimate product in skin and cell renewal, the cream is crafted with the purest and most effective nourishers, natural antioxidants, high-performance rejuvenators and enriched with Gold Bhasma".
The cream targets the seven signs of ageing, with a blend of naturally-sourced herbs and activators to plump the skin and reduce the appearance of pigmentation and wrinkles. It is also immersed in a rich Ayurvedic serum, made with 24 Karat Gold. The serum helps create a restorative hydration surge to moisturise skin, improving elasticity and firmness.
Priced at £96, the Transformative Soundarya Night Cream is available at
Forest Essentials
.
Noble Panacea launches two-step cleanser and exfoliator
Noble Panacea has launched a two-step treatment to "revolutionise skin initialisation for clarified and resurfaced skin", called the Elemental Cleansing Balm and Exfoliating Refiner.
The product aims to highlight the benefits of skin initialisation, a cleansing and preparing routine revolutionised to remove impurities, brighten hyperpigmentation and prepare the skin to ensure maximum efficacy of the subsequent skincare application.
As part of this, the science-backed skincare brand has used its OSMV Technology to create skincare that "elevates the skin initialisation step, through ultimate protection, programmed sequence, extreme precision and extended release".
Priced at £172, the Elemental Cleansing Balm and Exfoliating Refiner is available at
Noble Panacea
.
Molton Brown taps Heavenly Gingerlily fragrance for new collection
Molton Brown
has introduced a limited-edition bath and bodycare collection for its Heavenly Gingerlily fragrance.
The range, which includes a Bath & Shower Gel, Body Lotion, Fine Liquid Hand Wash and Hand Lotion, has been redesigned with an illustration of lilies for the spring season.
It has been created by master perfumer Jacques Chabert, who "visited a botanical garden and became captivated by the gingerlily bloom". The collection features notes of cardamom, ginger, lily, tuberose and tagetes, as well as sandalwood in the Hand Wash and Hand Lotion.
Priced from £22 to £30, the Heavenly Gingerlily collection is available at
Molton Brown
.
Cellular Goods launches 'pioneering' face serum
Science-backed, luxury skincare and wellness brand Cellular Goods has introduced a Rejuvenating Cannabinoid Face Serum.
The age preventative serum has been designed to "transform skin with a powerful anti-age peptide", proven to visibly reverse skin ageing more effectively than vitamin C and as effectively as retinol – without the associated dryness and irritation.
The skin soothing, anti-inflammatory solution, featuring clinically-tested cannabinoid CBG, promises "the future of skincare with unparalleled results".
Priced at £99, the Rejuvenating Cannabinoid Face Serum is available at
Cellular Goods
.
Spotlight Oral Care adds limited-edition colours to sonic toothbrush range
Spotlight Oral Care, the Ireland-based, dentist-led oral care brand, has added two limited-edition colours to its sonic toothbrush range. Morning Lilac and Midnight Navy were launched this week as a reminder that people should brush their teeth at least once in the morning and once in the evening.
The sonic toothbrush is the signature piece in the oral care collection created by sisters and dentists Dr Lisa and Dr Vanessa Creaven and first launched in 2016. The toothbrush is designed to be both "gentle and effective" at removing plaque and discolouration and features three different settings with various amplitude ranges. It comes complete with a two-minute self-timer, three brush heads, long-lasting battery and protective travel case.
Dr Lisa and Dr Vanessa Creaven said: “As dentists, we have a unique insight into the needs and concerns of our dental patients, which is why we are constantly innovating. Our award-winning Sonic Toothbrush is the smart way to improve both the health and beauty of your smile. Using our Sonic Toothbrush at home is the next best thing to having a scale and polish with your own hygienist or dentist.”
Priced at £110, the new limited-edition brushes are available exclusively from
Spotlight Oral Care
.
